scope: Observed whole-CLI resources, not theoretical complexity or causal effects.

definitions.models: ln(y)=c+sum beta ln(1+x); n_only OLS, other models standardized ridge alpha=1; medians of 3 repetitions
definitions.slopes: OLS ln(y) versus ln(n), per series and seed; finite-range observations, not asymptotic orders
definitions.validation: Refit within each training fold, leave one n/family/seed out; synthetic inputs only

historical_comparison_caveat: Same S/G, b/h/d, outer ranking and requested outputs; version, workers, host and date differ. No implementation-only speedup claim.
limitations: Three repetitions, fixed input cohort; S also changes between synthetic shapes.
Correlated geometry descriptors do not identify causal work or RSS bytes.
RNAcentral predictions extrapolate beyond synthetic n=250..4000, without refitting or resource calibration.
CapR reports no numeric root; successful complete profiles use the CLI's finite-root check.
